signs.name: Dangerous bend to the left
signs.meaning: The road bends sharply to the left.

signs.name: Dangerous bend to the right
signs.meaning: The road bends sharply to the right.

signs.name: Double bend, first left
signs.meaning: Two bends follow, and the first is to the left.

signs.name: Double bend, first right
signs.meaning: Two bends follow, and the first is to the right.

signs.name: Steep descent
signs.meaning: A steep downhill stretch starts here.

signs.name: Steep ascent
signs.meaning: A steep uphill stretch starts here.

signs.name: Slippery road
signs.meaning: The surface may be slippery, especially in rain.

signs.name: Uneven road
signs.meaning: Bumps, dips, or a rough surface ahead.

signs.name: Loose gravel
signs.meaning: Loose stones can be thrown by the wheels.

signs.name: Road narrows
signs.meaning: The carriageway becomes narrower on both sides.

signs.name: Road narrows on the left
signs.meaning: The left side of the road closes in.

signs.name: Road narrows on the right
signs.meaning: The right side of the road closes in.

signs.name: Opening bridge
signs.meaning: A bridge ahead can open for boats.

signs.name: Quayside
signs.meaning: The road runs next to water without a barrier.

signs.name: Road works
signs.meaning: People and machines may be working on the road.

signs.name: Traffic signals
signs.meaning: A signalised junction is coming up.

signs.name: Pedestrian crossing
signs.meaning: A crossing used by people on foot.

signs.name: Children
signs.meaning: Children may cross, often near a school.

signs.name: Cyclists
signs.meaning: Cyclists may enter or cross the road.

signs.name: Cattle
signs.meaning: Farm animals may be on the road.

signs.name: Wild animals
signs.meaning: Wild animals may cross, often at dusk.

signs.name: Falling rocks
signs.meaning: Rocks may fall onto the carriageway.

signs.name: Crosswinds
signs.meaning: Strong side wind on an open stretch.

signs.name: Low-flying aircraft
signs.meaning: Aircraft pass low over the road.

signs.name: Tunnel
signs.meaning: A tunnel starts ahead. Lights on.

signs.name: Other danger
signs.meaning: A hazard that has no sign of its own.

signs.name: Level crossing with barriers
signs.meaning: A railway crossing with gates or barriers.

signs.name: Level crossing without barriers
signs.meaning: A railway crossing with no gates.

signs.name: Tram crossing
signs.meaning: Tram tracks cross the road.

signs.name: Crossroads
signs.meaning: An intersection with a side road.

signs.name: Roundabout ahead
signs.meaning: A roundabout is coming. Give way as signed.

signs.name: Two-way traffic
signs.meaning: One-way flow ends and opposing traffic begins.

signs.name: Traffic queues
signs.meaning: Standing or slow traffic is likely.

signs.name: Soft verge
signs.meaning: The edge of the road is soft. Do not pull off hard.

signs.name: Ice
signs.meaning: The road may be icy.

signs.name: No entry
signs.meaning: Do not enter from this direction.

signs.name: Closed to all vehicles
signs.meaning: No vehicles may pass this point.

signs.name: No motor vehicles
signs.meaning: Cars and motorcycles are not allowed.

signs.name: No motorcycles
signs.meaning: Motorcycles may not pass.

signs.name: No bicycles
signs.meaning: Cycling is not allowed beyond the sign.

signs.name: No pedestrians
signs.meaning: People on foot may not enter.

signs.name: No trucks
signs.meaning: Goods vehicles are banned.

signs.name: No buses
signs.meaning: Buses may not use this road.

signs.name: No tractors
signs.meaning: Tractors and slow farm vehicles are banned.

signs.name: No trailers
signs.meaning: Vehicles towing a trailer may not pass.

signs.name: No hazardous cargo
signs.meaning: Vehicles with dangerous goods are banned.

signs.name: Weight limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles over the signed mass may not pass.

signs.name: Height limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles taller than the signed height must turn back.

signs.name: Width limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles wider than the signed width must turn back.

signs.name: Length limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles longer than the signed length are banned.

signs.name: No left turn
signs.meaning: Turning left is forbidden at this junction.

signs.name: No right turn
signs.meaning: Turning right is forbidden at this junction.

signs.name: No U-turn
signs.meaning: Turning around is forbidden.

signs.name: No overtaking
signs.meaning: Do not pass a moving motor vehicle.

signs.name: End of no overtaking
signs.meaning: The overtaking ban ends here.

signs.name: Speed limit 40
signs.meaning: Do not exceed 40 kilometres per hour.

signs.name: Speed limit 60
signs.meaning: Do not exceed 60 kilometres per hour.

signs.name: Speed limit 90
signs.meaning: Do not exceed 90 kilometres per hour.

signs.name: End of speed limit
signs.meaning: The previous speed limit no longer applies.

signs.name: No stopping
signs.meaning: Stopping is forbidden, even briefly.

signs.name: No parking
signs.meaning: Parking is forbidden. A short stop may be allowed.

signs.name: No horns
signs.meaning: Sound signals are forbidden except to avoid danger.

signs.name: Ahead only
signs.meaning: Continue straight. Do not turn.

signs.name: Turn left
signs.meaning: The only permitted direction is left.

signs.name: Turn right
signs.meaning: The only permitted direction is right.

signs.name: Straight or left
signs.meaning: You may go straight or turn left.

signs.name: Straight or right
signs.meaning: You may go straight or turn right.

signs.name: Keep left
signs.meaning: Pass the obstacle on its left.

signs.name: Keep right
signs.meaning: Pass the obstacle on its right.

signs.name: Pass either side
signs.meaning: You may pass the obstacle on either side.

signs.name: Roundabout
signs.meaning: Enter the roundabout in the signed direction.

signs.name: Cycle track
signs.meaning: Cyclists must use this track.

signs.name: Footpath
signs.meaning: Pedestrians must use this path.

signs.name: Shared path
signs.meaning: The path is for both cyclists and pedestrians.

signs.name: Minimum speed 40
signs.meaning: Do not travel slower than 40 kilometres per hour.

signs.name: Snow chains
signs.meaning: Snow chains are required from here.

signs.name: End of minimum speed
signs.meaning: The minimum speed no longer applies.

signs.name: Parking
signs.meaning: A place where parking is provided.

signs.name: Hospital
signs.meaning: A hospital is signed from here.

signs.name: First aid
signs.meaning: Medical help is available nearby.

signs.name: Filling station
signs.meaning: Fuel is available in the signed direction.

signs.name: Telephone
signs.meaning: A public telephone is nearby.

signs.name: Restaurant
signs.meaning: A place to eat is signed from here.

signs.name: Hotel
signs.meaning: Lodging is signed from here.

signs.name: Camping
signs.meaning: A campsite is signed from here.

signs.name: Picnic site
signs.meaning: A place to stop and eat outdoors.

signs.name: Bus stop
signs.meaning: Buses stop here.

signs.name: Tram stop
signs.meaning: Trams stop here.

signs.name: Taxi
signs.meaning: A taxi rank.

signs.name: Dead end
signs.meaning: The road does not continue through.

signs.name: One-way street
signs.meaning: Traffic on this street moves in one direction.

signs.name: Pedestrian zone
signs.meaning: The area is meant for people on foot.

signs.name: Living street
signs.meaning: A shared street. People on foot have priority.

signs.name: Motorway
signs.meaning: Motorway rules begin.

signs.name: End of motorway
signs.meaning: Motorway rules end.

signs.name: Give way
signs.meaning: Give way to traffic on the crossing road.

signs.name: Stop
signs.meaning: Stop completely, then give way.

signs.name: Priority road
signs.meaning: You are on the priority road.

signs.name: End of priority road
signs.meaning: The priority road ends.

signs.name: Priority over oncoming vehicles
signs.meaning: Oncoming traffic must wait for you.

signs.name: Give way to oncoming vehicles
signs.meaning: Wait if an oncoming vehicle is already in the narrow stretch.
